protocol.dataSource: existing frozen Bitkub OHLCV v13 dataset
protocol.policy: Freeze candidates before running this comparison. Previously examined historical dates are development evidence only. Evaluate both planners with identical next-snapshot fills, no future OHLC in signals, full exit fees and explicit synthetic depth/neutral news. Standard-fee training chooses the candidate; credit cases cannot approve standard-fee trading. Report validation diagnostics for every frozen candidate without selecting on validation. No result automatically changes a live account, risk limit or approval.

limitations: Previously examined dates are development replay, not a new blind holdout or a profit guarantee.
Six surviving coins/current metadata, synthetic spread/ample depth and neutral news do not reproduce the full live universe or historical order books.
Signal uses closed candles; a fill is only allowed at the limit on the next bar open if marketable. Queue position, partial fills and the real two-minute lifetime are unobserved.
Five-minute risk checks can miss intra-candle adverse moves. All exits pay full fees; entry-credit cases start with a hypothetical 1000 THB credit budget.
Gross target is an inferred price move, never a forecast. No account, risk setting or approval is changed by this report.
